# CalGreen Energy Services

> > CalGreen Energy Services provides compliance, inspection, and commissioning services for California's Green Building Standards Code (CalGreen) across residential and commercial projects.

Founded by Gary Welch and operating through the Greennature Foundation, CalGreen Energy Services specializes in helping architects, builders, and building departments navigate CalGreen and Title 24 requirements. The company serves municipalities including Tracy, Fresno, Santa Rosa, Stockton, Los Angeles, and El Dorado County with ICC-certified special inspectors and comprehensive compliance solutions.

## Key Topics

- CalGreen Code (California Green Building Standards Code)
- Title 24 Compliance
- CalGreen Commissioning
- CalGreen Special Inspection
- ICC Certified CalGreen Special Inspectors
- CalGreen Checklists (AIA and Municipal)
- Residential CalGreen Compliance
- Commercial CalGreen Requirements
- Building Department Support
- Architectural Plan Notes
- Factory-Built Homes Compliance
- 2025 CalGreen Code Changes
- Municipal CalGreen Services (Tracy, Fresno, Santa Rosa, Stockton, Los Angeles)
- Green Building Standards
- Energy Services and Inspections

## Core Services

- [CalGreen Inspector Services](https://calgreenenergyservices.com/calgreen-services/calgreen-inspector-services): CalGreen inspection services for residential & commercial CA projects
- [CalGreen Commissioning Services](https://calgreenenergyservices.com/calgreen-services/calgreen-commissioning-services): CalGreen & Title 24 commissioning services for CA building projects

- [2025 CalGreen Code Changes](https://calgreenenergyservices.com/2025/09/12/2025-calgreen-code-changes): Complete summary of 2025 California CalGreen mandatory code changes

- [CalGreen for Commercial Buildings](https://calgreenenergyservices.com/2019/12/29/calgreen-for-commercial-projects): CalGreen compliance requirements and coordination for commercial buildings
- [Cal Green for Factory-Built Homes](https://calgreenenergyservices.com/2020/08/10/cal-green-for-factory-built-homes): CalGreen compliance guide for manufactured and factory-built housing
